acceptance_verification.lifecycle_actions_and_transitions: All 12 lifecycle actions implemented in ProgramService with CAS state transitions matching evolution-lifecycle.md D1/D2/D3: submit_evolution_review, approve_program, pause_program, resume_program, complete_program, retire_program, stop, freeze_generation, unfreeze_generation, promote_candidate_paper, promote_candidate_live, approve_mutation, reject_mutation.
acceptance_verification.d1_pause_drain_and_stop_semantics: pause_program halts new generation admission and sets status='paused'; resume_program verifies paused status and sets resumed_attempts: True. stop sets status='stopped' and cancels nonterminal runs; resume_program strictly refuses to reverse a stop (409 conflict). retire_program accepts completed or stopped programs.
acceptance_verification.d2_freeze_semantics: freeze_generation marks is_frozen: True; while frozen, approve_mutation and promote_candidate_paper are rejected with 409 conflict; unfreeze_generation restores is_frozen: False.
acceptance_verification.d3_steering_actions: create_constraint, create_fitness_formula, create_mutation_rule append durable configuration to program records and return domain receipts.
acceptance_verification.payload_alignment_and_no_synthetic_ids: BFF EvolutionCommandAdapter flattens candidate_id, run_id, mutation_id, artifact_id to top-level fields matching ProgramActionRequest; passes Idempotency-Key, X-Idempotency-Key, and X-Tenant-Id HTTP headers; program_router reads headers with fallback to body; candidate promotions require candidate_id; mutation approvals require caller mutation_id and raise 422 if missing, eliminating synthetic ID fabrication.
acceptance_verification.no_live_capital_or_trading: live_capital_side_effects is strictly False across all receipts, models, and command adapters. Candidate promotions record capital_authority='none'. No live trading or production capital side-effects authorized.
acceptance_verification.idempotency_and_divergent_replay: Idempotency-Key and X-Idempotency-Key headers are transported from BFF EvolutionCommandAdapter through http_request_json to Evolution program_router and ProgramStore CAS; idempotent replays with matching digest return committed program and receipt with idempotent_replay: True without re-running transition checks; divergent replays raise 409 conflict; verified via unit and end-to-end router tests.
acceptance_verification.role_gating: Approver actions require approver or admin role at both BFF router (403 FORBIDDEN) and service layer (422 validation error).
